title: Babies Born to Teenage Mothers in Past Five Years and Assistance Provided
what_it_is: Babies Born to Teenage Mothers in Past Five Years and Assistance Provided

sections.label: Support for pregnant minors
sections.summary: Pregnant minors get emotional and practical support from a multidisciplinary team, which continues follow-up after childbirth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Pregnant mothers who are minors receive emotional and practical support from a multidisciplinary team that includes doctors and nurses, counsellors and medical social workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Following childbirth, the team will also continue to follow up with the mother for review.

sections.label: ComCare and KidSTART help
sections.summary: Social Service Offices can give ComCare assistance to young mothers in lower-income households, and eligible pregnant mothers can join KidSTART.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For instance, the Social Service Offices (SSOs) can provide ComCare assistance to young mothers in lower-income households.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Eligible pregnant mothers can also join KidSTART, which will provide additional support to help them keep well physically and mentally before childbirth and equip them to nurture their child's development after their child is born.

sections.label: Vicious cycle and statistics
sections.summary: A possible vicious cycle may need addressing, and the Member is referred to file a PQ with MHA for statistics held by ICA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, I think there might be a vicious cycle ahead that we might need to address.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I would refer the Member to file a PQ with the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) for a breakdown of the statistics as they reside in ICA.

sections.label: Dedicated social worker approach
sections.summary: A dedicated social worker is one example, but a multidimensional approach is needed so the problem does not persist across generations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The provision of a dedicated social worker is one example of how we can journey together with each of these cases, but I think there is more to it than just the provision of social workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We are talking about a multidimensional approach so that there is a better chance that this problem does not persist, as in the case that Mr Louis Ng brought up, across generations.

sections.label: Stakeholders raising alerts
sections.summary: Medical social workers, family members, teachers or school staff can raise the alert to social service agencies for wrap-around support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, it could well be the medical social worker at the point of a visit to the hospital or the clinic by the person in view, by the teenage mom, or it could well be the family members who raise the alarm, or it could well be teachers and staff from the school.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, what I was trying to say earlier in my reply to the Member's supplementary question was that anyone, any number of stakeholders and parties within this figurative "village", has to step up and raise the alert to social service agencies, to social service officers, so that we can all provide a wrap-around 360-degree-support for each of these cases.
